settings.editor: We work closely with every client we take on, which means spaces are limited. Submit your details below and we’ll be in touch soon.
Honest answers to your questions.

tabs.tab_content:
In a nutshell, it starts with you getting a quote and applying to work with us. If we think you’re a good fit, we’ll ask you to send through your current resume and the roles you’re targeting so we can assess what needs to change.

Then the real start of the process is the 30 to 45 minute deep dive, where we unpack your background and pull out the examples and achievements most people leave off their resume. Over the next 2 to 3 business days, we build your resume from the ground up — a completely done-for-you service, with two weeks of revisions and our interview guarantee.

tabs.tab_title: Do you help with government applications?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, we assist with all Australian government applications, including APS applications, Local, State & Federal Government positions, Executive Level (EL1/2), and Senior Executive Service (SES) bands across QLD, NSW, VIC & WA.

tabs.tab_title: Do you assist with selection criteria?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, we specialise in selection criteria in full alignment with Australian standards. We craft detailed, compelling responses tailored to the specific role. Please book a call to discuss your circumstances.
To get started, you can either choose a package or book a Free Career Mapping session to discuss your options.

tabs.tab_title: My industry is specific. Can you help?
tabs.tab_content: Absolutely. Our experience spans 1000+ clients across countless industries — Accounting & Finance, Engineering, Government & Defence, Healthcare, IT & Telecommunications, Legal, Mining, Project Management, Sales & Marketing and many more. There hasn’t been a role we’ve been unable to write for.
Our pricing is highly competitive, especially compared to similar premium services that typically range from $1500 to $3000. Please contact us for detailed pricing.
Absolutely. With our expertise, personalised support, and proven track record, you get premium quality assistance and a significant return on investment through increased opportunities.

tabs.tab_title: How do I find a great resume writer?
tabs.tab_content: The industry is notorious for fake reviews and offshoring. Look for genuine third-party reviews, insist on working one-on-one with a dedicated consultant, and if you’re speaking with a sales rep rather than your writer — hang up.
Your resume is written by Australian-based professionals with backgrounds in HR, marketing, recruitment and communications.
Yes — three. A 100% satisfaction guarantee with two weeks of unlimited revisions, a 60-day interview guarantee, and a money-back guarantee if you change your mind before we start.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a resume or CV?
tabs.tab_content: In Australia the terms are used interchangeably for most positions. For academic or medical roles, a more detailed CV is typically preferred. We can guide you on what suits your needs.
ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) are tools recruiters use to filter applications. We craft your resume to rank within the top 2% of ATS-scanned candidates.
Yes — we leverage industry and role insights to rank you as a top 10% applicant on LinkedIn.

tabs.tab_title: How do I receive the documents?
tabs.tab_content: We deliver in Word and PDF formats to ensure compatibility and maintain formatting integrity.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer a free resume review?
tabs.tab_content: You’re welcome to send your resume to info@resumedna.com for a complimentary review, handled as time allows. For serious improvement, we recommend booking a consultation call.
